pages.title: Afrit Attractive
pages.text: The orange chalk is a perfect bait for spirits of the Afrit class, who,$(br) although impressed by the lime chalk, can resist its call.$(br)

Being a sweet and slightly warm chalk, it does not guarantee control over the invoked Afrit.$(br) Commanding an Afrit requires power directly related to its class of spirits and$(br) extreme stability in the pentacle.$(br)
To obtain the $(item)Cursed Honey$() for $(item)Orange Chalk$() you need to$(br) $(l:possession_rituals/possess_bee)summon and kill a Possessed Bee$(/l)$(br)
